mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDP is increasing, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a reduction in supply, which can lead to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate indicates a strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by a CPI increase of less than 2% annually, signals a stable economic environment, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls combined with an increase in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases & UNRATE increases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS is increasing, the hypothesis is rejected.
